noControl.desktop:StartRenamingNote: a double-click or F2 on a note row, labelled by its title
noControl.desktop:StartRenamingFolder: a double-click or F2 on a folder row, labelled by its path
noControl.desktop:SubmitRename: Enter in the inline rename field, or leaving it (TreeRowRename.svelte)

noControl.desktop:ToggleSortMenu: the sort button is DropdownMenu.svelte's toggle, labelled through its label prop

noControl.desktop:CancelAddingTag: Escape in the tag field, AddTag's control
